category.reason: Map the action intent in the original query to the page control. Route action on a detailed map place card

instruction.en: Use the route-planning control in the left details card for 杭州东站.
instruction.zh: 使用左侧“杭州东站”详情卡中的路线规划控件。

reference.patch: The original request to plan a route to Hangzhou East Railway Station did not specify an entry point. The screenshot contains both the '去这里' control in the station's left details card and a route-arrow icon beside its map label, while the groundTruth accepts only the details-card control. Rewrote both instructions to specify the route-planning control in the left details card and used the station's visible Chinese name, '杭州东站'. This distinguishes the intended target from the map icon without assuming that the two controls have identical behavior. The existing groundTruth remains on the left details-card control.
